# Guide Package Conventions

## Rules

- Hexagonal, one-way imports:
  - `domain/` — entities, value objects, domain errors, domain services. MUST NOT import `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `application/` — use-case interactors, queries, driven ports. Depends only on `domain/`. MUST NOT import `infrastructure/`, `composition/`.
  - `infrastructure/` — driven adapters (static pre-bundled catalog storage; in-memory BM25 via `minisearch`). Depends on `domain/` + `application/`.
  - `composition/` — DI factories, composition root, facade `createGuideEngine()`.
- `src/public.ts` — curated barrel for package `.` export. Expose only facade, supported domain types, options, errors, host utilities. MUST NOT leak adapters, bundle assets, or SDK catalog factory.
- `src/index.ts` — broader internal barrel for `./internal`. MAY re-export application + infrastructure symbols. MUST NOT expose SDK catalog factory or generated SDK catalog.
- Standalone: MUST NOT declare runtime dependency on `@specd/core`, `@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`.
  - Self-contained; run in lightweight hosts (CI runners, client CLI binaries, MCP server processes) without SpecD kernel, AST parsers, delta engines, schema validators.
  - Markdown frontmatter + heading parsing for bundling MUST occur strictly at build time.
  - Runtime lookup MAY load pre-bundled JSON catalog assets. MUST NOT read documentation source roots or parse Markdown, frontmatter, or TypeDoc output at runtime.
  - Every runtime JSON catalog asset MUST be included in the published package alongside entry points that load it.
- Errors under `domain/errors/` (per `guide:errors`):
  - All domain errors MUST extend `SpecdGuideError`, implementing SpecD Error Contract (`specd = true`, `code: string`) without importing `@specd/core`.
  - `GuideTopicNotFoundError`, `GuideSectionNotFoundError` MUST be thrown by application queries, handled gracefully by delivery adapters.
- `packages/guide/` standard monorepo assets:
  - `package.json` — name `@specd/guide`, `type` `module`, scripts `build`, `test`, `lint`, clean dependency declarations.
  - Entry points via `exports` only. MUST NOT be required to declare `main` or `types`, and MUST NOT declare those fields as delivery mechanism.
  - `exports` MUST declare `.`, `./internal`, `./sdk`.
  - `build` and `build:dev` MUST run catalog bundler before bundler output is consumed.
  - Build-time documentation tooling MUST be a `devDependency` and MUST NOT become a runtime dependency.
  - `tsconfig.json` — matches monorepo compiler settings.
  - `vitest.config.ts` — Vitest test config.
  - `test/` — unit + integration covering domain models, queries, adapters, composition facade.
- `packages/guide/README.md` MUST document:
  - Overview, motivation, zero-runtime-core-dependency design.
  - Architecture diagram of hexagonal layers (`domain/`, `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`).
  - Catalog of pre-bundled guide topics.
  - Quick start: initialize `createGuideEngine()`, invoke queries.
  - Data schema: `GuideTopic`, `GuideSection`, `GuideOutline`, `GuideSearchHit`, `GuideSummary`.
  - SDK collection entry point and how to reach it.
  - Documented topic catalog MUST stay in parity with generated user collection. Every README topic MUST exist in catalog; every catalog topic MUST be documented. Mismatch is a documentation defect requiring correction in the same change.

## Constraints

- Zero runtime dependencies on `@specd/core`.
- Monorepo package conventions observed across all directories and files.
- All line numbers across the package MUST be 1-indexed.
